task_metadata.research_topic: Preference optimization loss design for math reasoning LLMs
task_metadata.research_question: Can a custom DPO-family preference loss beat DPO/SimPO/IPO/ORPO when fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct on Math-Step-DPO-10K and evaluating on GSM8K/MATH-500/AIME-2024?
notes: Task is aligned with Step-DPO (Lai et al. 2024, arXiv:2406.18629): same preference dataset (xinlai/Math-Step-DPO-10K) and the same math evaluation suite (GSM8K, MATH-500, AIME-2024). Base model scaled down to Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct to fit a 4-GPU budget.

tests.label: train
tests.notes: Full-parameter DPO of Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct on Math-Step-DPO-10K.

tests.label: math_eval
tests.notes: Single-pass vLLM eval; sympy+mathd grader for GSM8K, MATH-500, AIME-2024.

baselines.name: dpo
baselines.notes: DPO (Rafailov et al. 2023): pref_loss=sigmoid with reference model.

baselines.name: simpo
baselines.notes: SimPO (Meng et al. 2024): reference-free length-normalized loss with margin gamma=1.0, beta=2.0.

baselines.name: ipo
baselines.notes: IPO (Azar et al. 2023): squared-loss preference optimization with reference model.

baselines.name: orpo
baselines.notes: ORPO (Hong et al. 2024): reference-free odds-ratio preference loss + NLL on chosen.
